nom: Vichy 16% Pure Vitamin C Brightening Serum

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the serum feels lightweight, non-greasy and does not clog pores.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report it absorbs well and leaves skin glowing without irritation or over-drying, though one found the thin liquid hard to spread and another found it drying.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report good tolerance and fading dark spots, though one describes the worst comedones she's ever had after two weeks.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who identify as sensitive mostly report no irritation and good tolerance, but one sensitive-skin reviewer broke out badly around the mouth and chin.
segments.mature: Reviewers around or above 40-50 report smoother, calmer, more radiant skin and fading age spots, with one exception who broke out with large, slow-healing pimples.

concerns.aging: Several mature reviewers report softer fine lines, smoother texture and a calming effect over weeks of use; results on wrinkles are described as slight or inconclusive by others.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including dry-skin users, report a hydrated, non-stripped feel; one reviewer notes the label states the product is drying and reports no visible improvement.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with texture and dullness concerns reports her redness settled down after about a week of use; this is the only specific mention of redness improving.
concerns.barrier: Not enough reviewers discuss barrier function specifically to characterize a pattern.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report fading dark spots, sun spots, hyperpigmentation, and melasma improvement within one to several weeks; effects are described as gradual, not immediate for most.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report no new breakouts and even improvement in hormonal breakouts and acne scars; however, multiple others report new comedones, cystic-type pimples, or acne around the mouth after starting the product.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin consistently report the serum feels non-greasy and absorbs without leaving residue; no reviewer reports increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Watery, runny consistency hard to control
Good value versus premium vitamin C serums

extraits.texte: I got a sample size of this, within 2 weeks of using it I broke out with the worse case comedones i've ever had. Literally gave my skin texture when I barely had any. Im still recovering. Im not saying this will happen to everyone, but be aware it could happen. I have combination skin.

I was looking for a good Vitamin C and came across this one and decided to give it a try. It feels nice going on and sinks in quickly. It didn't irritate or dry out my skin which is a big plus for me as i have dry skin. Sadly i ended up breaking out with large pimples that are taking forever to go away. As i woman that it is almost 40 and who hardly ever gets a pimple i am highly disappointed with this product. I also very much disliked the applicator of this product.

26(F) noticed signs of aging, and this was highly recommended to me. Since starting this, I have been breaking out in terrible acne around my mouth and chin. I didn't know that this was a very strong serum that would ruin my skin :(

extraits.titre: Finally an Affordable Quality Vitamin C
extraits.texte: This product goes on smooth, absorbs well, and will leave you feeling brighter. I was skeptical because I've tried really expensive Vitamin Cs like Skincueticals but just couldn't afford to keep purchasing such expensive products. This is definitely inline with a lot of accessible skincare as far as price. I have always suffered from skin texture issues as well as dull skin. This product had me looking brighter in about a week! My skin tone evened out, my texture had calmed down and my redness had also settled down! Very happy with this product. I will say that when using, you should be on top of your sunscreen because it did make me skin more sensitive to the sun when I forgot sunblock.

I actually found this product on a clearance shelf at another store, I looked up the reviews and saw it had various great reviews from different websites/customers. I am on day 3 and I am so thrilled with the results. My skin is already looking so much better. Dark spots and acne scars appear lighter, and overall my skin looks healthier. This is the only item I added or changed to my routine, and I see a vast difference already. will continue to use this product and would recommend! Sources say, it can cause slight purging of the skin, so if this breaks you out temporarily, keep using, it will clear up!

I often use a vitamin C serum, or other products with antioxidants, so I was interested when Vichy sent me a sample of the LiftActive 16% Vitamin C serum to try and review through BzzAgent's sampling program. I did not know i would like this product as much as I do! It goes on silky and feels soft on skin. I enjoy it alone under moisturizer or mixed in. It helped clear my monthly hormonal breakouts, and gave me a little "glow", without irritating my skin. I feel i saw more visible results with this than several other similar products. One note... it comes in a dropper top bottle that might be a little awkward for some people, (maybe a pump might work better?). But, the product is great and I'll definitely continue to use it!

I have combination skin and sometimes can be dry and sometimes oily this serum is great never caused any irritation only inprovments. It absorbs fast after few uses my dark spots were fading and looked brighter and even my lines were less visible. I will be continuing using this.
